description: Hello,This posting is for a super clean and great running 2017 Subaru WRX STI that I have just recently completed a TON of major work on!The STI comes with a 2.5L turbocharged 4 cylinder engine, mated to a 6 speed manual gear box with center differential control. This allows you to lock the differentials like a 4X4 offroad truck or move more power to the rear making it more rear biased. It comes with power windows, mirrors, door locks with key less entry and heated front seats.Now to the important stuff. I have just completely overhauled the entire engine with all new seals and gaskets througout to make this Subaru EXTREMELY reliable for many more years and miles to come, as well as a couple upgrades to make it ready and reliable for more power if thats the route you choose to go. It has a brand new STI RA block which is stronger than the normal STI as well as having the heads machined and gone through with valve adjust. I assembled it with ARP 625+ head studs with all oem seals and gaskets going back together. Brand new oil pump, oil cooler, complete timing kit and clutch kit. Flywheel included, spark plugs thermostat and all new fresh fluids throughout. Brand new power steering/alternator belt and AC belt as well. The only engine modifications to this vehicle are a COBB intake and Invidia cat back exhaust. This car is 100% ready to rock and roll and has just over 120 miles on break in. I have receipts for every single part used on this build.The exterior of the car I would say is in very good shape for the age and miles, it does have some dings, dents, and scratches but absolutely no major body damage or rust. The paint on the front bumper could be resprayed to have it perfect but it has normal wear and tear of a vehicle with this mileage.The interior of the vehicle is a solid 9.5/10 with the only minor wear being on the driver seat bulster. Otherwise the interor of the car is extremely clean and in great shape. Everything works as it should.

Introducing the 2017 Ford F-250 Super Duty Platinum, the ultimate truck for all your heavy-duty needs. This powerhouse of a vehicle is designed to tackle any task with ease, while providing luxurious comfort and advanced technology.

Under the hood, you'll find a robust 6.7L Power Stroke V8 Turbo Diesel engine, delivering an impressive 440 horsepower and 925 lb-ft of torque. This means you'll have the power and capability to tow up to 18,000 pounds and haul up to 3,900 pounds, making it the perfect truck for work or play.
